newsitem.title: USA: EMCON sees restructuring charge in Q4.
newsitem.headline: EMCON sees restructuring charge in Q4.

text.p: EMCON Associates said it was implementing a restructuring plan, resulting in pre-tax charges of $13 to $14 million in the fourth quarter of 1996.

The charges will reflect costs relating to planned asset and goodwill write-offs, employee severance, closure and downsizing of several offices and an increase in reserves relating to pending litigation.

Due to these charges, EMCON expects reporting a pre-tax loss for the year of between $13 and $14.5 million. The above estimates are subject to completion of the company's year-end audit and the expected release of audited results in March.
EMCON also signed a letter of intent to sell its Columbia Analytical Services (CAS) division to CAS management for cash, notes and other consideration valued at $7.5 million.

The sale is expected to be completed by the end of the first quarter of 1997. It has also negotiated the sale of two of its landfill gas-to-energy projects which, when completed, will bring in additional cash proceeds of $1.8 million.
It said its balance sheet remains healthy and that it enters 1997 with backlog at a record level.
